frontmatter.title: About Data Analysis
frontmatter.description: Introduction to data analysis and dimensional analysis for water resources engineering, covering data types, experimental setups, and traditional methods for deriving insights.

children.value: Traditionally, dimensional analysis were used to derive insights from different experimental setups and survey environments. This chapter briefly digs into the type of data and explains traditional data insights with dimensional analysis.
We differentiate between data in the form of nominal, ordinal, interval, and ratio representations (cf. MA Negreiros chpt 2.1.1).
